covered_sections: PDF 1–3, 5–38: title, declaration, spectroscopy question, quantities, shape and detector background
PDF 39–85: reaction, geometry, calibrations, coincidence matrices, contaminants, angular observables and band placements
PDF 86–109: octupole and gamma-band diagnostics, model alternatives and conclusions

comparison_coverage: Bvumbi PRC 87 PDF 3–6 (with JYX cover on PDF 1); its 152Gd run is 45 MeV 152Sm(alpha,4n), independent of Netshiya 25 MeV 150Sm(alpha,2n).
remaining: The two 585-keV transitions have different upper and lower states and different angular evidence. No unique assignment is made from energy alone.
The 212-keV spin/parity labels are transposed in thesis Table 5.1. The DCO is missing for this branch and the E1 classification is tentative.

The thesis provides AP, not a tabulated calibrated P with Q per transition. Branching ratios and level-energy diagnostics constrain models without uniquely establishing static octupole or gamma shape.
